title: Market-neutral relative reversal between US equity index futures (NQ, RTY, YM each vs ES)
rule: spread return = r_X - beta x r_ES (beta 120-day rolling, lagged); z = L-day cumulative spread return / (sd of daily spread x sqrt(L)), 120-day sd; when z < -th go long X / short beta ES (and the mirror when z > th); signal from the close of day t, traded at the close of t+1 (one full day lag), held L days; size so each pair runs at 10%/3 vol (60-day spread vol); cost_frac on both legs
judgement: current 10-sleeve book (with Gen155 R1) + entrant, Sharpe-weighted on 2010-22; ONE evaluation 2023-26 vs 0.842
